title: Qur'an Challenge
subtitle: A comprehensive quiz covering the entire Qur'an by Juz' and Hizb — from An-Nas to Al-Baqarah
description: Progress through all 30 Juz' and 60 Hizb of the Qur'an in reverse memorisation order. Start with the short surahs at the end and work your way up to Al-Baqarah — just like we memorise!
